text: As someone who has been playing for the past 11 years, I feel like I'm obligated to say that this is one of the best platforms out there, otherwise I never would've been playing this long. That aside, there are quite a few issues regarding connection. Roblox is less of a 'game' and more of a massive, user-generated platform. The variety is unmatched—you can play anything from intense shooters to quiet roleplaying games. It’s great that it encourages creativity and coding skills, especially through Roblox Studio. However, because the games are user-made, the quality can be hit-or-miss. The platform also relies heavily on in-game currency (Robux), which can be annoying, but it's fun to explore.
